title: Pure Sphinx

allow.Book of Moon: Sphinx of the Cycle sets it from the Deck or GY by name; it turns a Guardian Sphinx face-down for another Flip Summon.
allow.Book of Taiyou: Sphinx of the Cycle sets it from the Deck or GY by name; it flips a face-down monster and triggers Sphinx of the Cycle.
allow.Adamancipator Researcher: A Level 2 Rock Tuner that needs no Adamancipator card: it summons itself from the hand while you control any Rock. Half Slice of Nickeline searches it, and it turns Half Slice's Synchro effect into an extra Normal Summon for a Sphinx.
allow.Adamancipator Risen - Dragite: Level 8 Synchro from Doki Doki, Half Slice of Nickeline and Adamancipator Researcher. Its negate only needs a WATER monster in the GY, which Half Slice is, and every Rock it excavates bounces a card.
allow.Adamancipator Signs: Revives any Rock monster from the GY in Defense Position, so it brings back a Sphinx without Tributes; on Adamancipator Researcher it also stacks a Level 4 or lower Rock on top of the Deck.
allow.Aussa the Earth Charmer, Immovable: Tagged Charmer, but it takes any 2 monsters including an EARTH one, which Doki Doki covers. It turns an EARTH monster in the opponent's GY into a Tribute for a Sphinx, and its float searches Doki Doki or Hieracosphinx.
allow.The Monarchs Stormforth: Its Tribute-the-opponent's-monster effect works for any Tribute Summon: a Sphinx Tribute Summoned off the opponent's monster removes it past targeting and destruction protection.

exclude.Number 68: Sanaphond the Sky Prison: Stops Special Summons from the GY, which shuts off Sphinx of the Cycle's revive.

summary: The Guardian Sphinx control build, with generic Rock starters and staples. Every Sphinx monster is an EARTH Rock of Level 5 or higher, so generic Rocks put them on the field without Tributes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Doki Doki discards a Rock to Special Summon one with the same Attribute and Level from the Deck: Guardian Sphinx for Guardian Sphinx, Criosphinx for Hieracosphinx, or Sphinx of the Cycle for Pharaonic Guardian Sphinx, face-down and ready to Flip Summon next turn.
Half Slice of Nickeline, Special Summoned from the Deck, adds Adamancipator Researcher: a Level 2 Rock Tuner that summons itself while you control a Rock.

summary.title: Opening: Doki Doki + Half Slice
steps: Normal Summon Doki Doki and discard Half Slice to summon the other copy from the Deck; it adds Adamancipator Researcher.
Special Summon Researcher from the hand, then take route A or B.

summary.title: Route A: Tri-Edge Master
summary.text: Synchro Summon Tri-Edge Master with Half Slice and Researcher: a Level 2 and a Level 4 draw a card. Half Slice went to the GY as Synchro Material, so you get a second Normal Summon: Tribute Doki Doki for a Level 5 or 6 Sphinx. With Doki Doki as a third material, make Adamancipator Risen - Dragite instead; it negates a Spell or Trap while the WATER Half Slice is in the GY.

summary.title: Route B: Gallant Granite
summary.text: Synchro Summon Old Entity Cthugua, a Level 4, with Doki Doki and Researcher, then use it and Half Slice for Gallant Granite, which draws a card because Cthugua was its material. Granite detaches to Special Summon a Sphinx of any Level from the hand face-down, ready to Flip Summon next turn, or to add any Rock from the Deck.

summary.title: Sphinx of the Cycle
summary.text: Whenever a monster's battle position changes, the newest Sphinx Special Summons itself from the hand or GY by banishing a Spell from the GY. Book of Moon on your own monster sets that off, and Book of Moon is then the Spell it banishes. On the field, it Sets Book of Moon and Book of Taiyou from the Deck, and once per turn it bounces a card when another monster changes position. Tribute it for the other Sphinxes: it comes back the next time a position changes.

summary.title: Control
points: Guardian Sphinx and Pharaonic Guardian Sphinx turn themselves face-down every turn. Flip Summoned again, they return all the opponent's monsters to the hand or shuffle them into the Deck.
Criosphinx makes every bounced monster cost its owner a card from the hand.
Sphinx of the Cycle and Pharaonic Guardian Sphinx make Number 23: Lancelot, Dark Knight of the Underworld. Each time it detaches Sphinx of the Cycle to negate, the Sphinx can come back from the GY.

summary.title: Spells
points: Sunset Beat destroys a card each time one of your monsters turns face-down, which the Guardian Sphinxes and Golem Sentry do on their own every turn. Terrors in the Hidden City stops the opponent from targeting them while they wait face-down.
Sol and Luna changes two monsters at once, one of theirs and one of yours, on either turn, so it summons Sphinx of the Cycle or makes it bounce.
Adamancipator Signs revives any Rock in Defense Position: a Sphinx Doki Doki discarded or you Tributed, or Researcher for another Synchro.
Superconductive Plasma Blast destroys a card on your turn and gets a Rock back on theirs. The Monarchs Stormforth lets a Sphinx Tribute one of their monsters when going second.
Foolish Burial sends Sphinx of the Cycle to the GY; Book of Moon on any monster then brings it back. Banish Foolish Burial for the cost, so Sphinx of the Cycle can Set Book of Moon again from the GY.
Every Spell in the GY is fuel for Sphinx of the Cycle's revive.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Prediction Princess partner, and Chronomaly Winged Sphinx and Triamid Sphinx, which belong to other archetypes. The page's Pyramid of Light OTK is a different deck that needs Andro Sphinx and Sphinx Teleia together in hand.

main: Sphinx of the Cycle
Newest card: sets the Books from the Deck, revives itself on any position change, and bounces a card.
Guardian Sphinx
Turns itself face-down; when Flip Summoned, bounces all their monsters.
Pharaonic Guardian Sphinx
Turns itself face-down; when Flip Summoned, shuffles their monsters into the Deck.
Criosphinx
Each bounced monster costs its owner a card from the hand.
Hieracosphinx
Your face-down monsters can't be attacked.
Doki Doki
Generic Rock starter: discards a Sphinx to summon a same-Level Sphinx from the Deck face-down, no Tribute needed.
Half Slice of Nickeline
Generic Rock: summoned from the Deck, it adds Adamancipator Researcher; as Synchro Material, it grants a second Normal Summon for a Sphinx.
Adamancipator Researcher
Level 2 Rock Tuner: summons itself while you control a Rock; Synchro Summons with Half Slice.
Golem Sentry
Generic Level 4 Rock: turns itself face-down; when Flip Summoned, bounces 1 of their monsters. Tribute for the Sphinxes.
Book of Moon
Quick-Play: turns a monster face-down; triggers Sphinx of the Cycle.
Book of Taiyou
Flips a face-down monster face-up; triggers Sphinx of the Cycle.
Foolish Burial
Limited. Sends Sphinx of the Cycle to the GY, ready to revive on the next position change, and pays its banish cost itself.
Superconductive Plasma Blast
Rock Quick-Play. Your turn: stacks a Rock on top of the Deck and destroys a card. Their turn: adds a Rock back from the field, GY or banishment.
Adamancipator Signs
Revives any Rock in Defense Position: a Sphinx Doki Doki discarded, or Researcher for another Synchro.
Sol and Luna
Quick-Play: turns one of their monsters face-down and flips or hides one of yours; two position changes for Sphinx of the Cycle.
Sunset Beat
Destroys a card whenever your monster turns face-down: Guardian Sphinx, Pharaonic Guardian Sphinx and Golem Sentry do it every turn.
Terrors in the Hidden City
Your face-down monsters can't be targeted; flipped face-up, they gain 1500 ATK/DEF.
The Monarchs Stormforth
Going second: Tribute one of their monsters for a Sphinx.
